summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested recursive add_to_cbd helper covering W3C CBD rules 1 and 2 (subject triples, blank-node expansion guarded by "result already has a subject triple for that node") and rule 3 (all triples of any statement whose rdf:subject is the node, no type or predicate/object matching). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with class CbdTestCase (setUp/tearDown, testCbd, testCbdReified, testCbdIncomingReificationExcluded, testCbdReifierBlankNodeNotExpanded, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testSourceGraphUnchanged, testCbdConjunctiveGraph). Expected counts were derived by hand from my own fixture; nothing was run, and nothing was committed.
